positions.desc: The Chancellor is the Councillor in charge of diplomatic efforts, both inside and outside the Realm.

positions.desc: The Steward is the Councillor in charge of Domain administration, for example matters of Taxation, Culture and Development.
positions.name: Steward

positions.desc: The Marshal is your chief Commander and the Councillor in charge of military matters in general.
positions.name: Marshal

positions.desc: The Spymaster is your Councillor in charge of matters of intrigue and intelligence. Beware of having a disloyal Spymaster, for they can easily conceal and participate in a Murder against you and your close family!

positions.desc:
The Court Chaplain is the Councillor in charge of religious and spiritual affairs in Faiths with the Lay Clergy Doctrine.

Faiths with the Theocratic Doctrine have the far more powerful (and troublesome) Realm Priest instead of a Court Chaplain.
positions.name: Court Chaplain

ownerModifiers.scale: court chaplain learn on the job

positions.desc:
A Spouse is a Character's husband or wife; the result of a Marriage.

In order to have legitimate offspring and produce Heirs, you should have a Spouse or Concubine (though Bastards can be legitimized).

The only way of forging an Alliance is through marriage or Betrothal; your own or that of a close relative.

Your (main) Spouse is also a member of your Council and can perform many useful Councillor Tasks.

Faith Doctrines determine how many Spouses you can have and how they can be Divorced.
positions.name: Spouse

positions.desc: As a Clan Government Ruler you can decide to assign either your Vizier or any of your Spouses as your Confidant. Whoever you choose will support you in your daily tasks.
positions.name: Confidant

positions.desc:
The Kurultai replaces the Council for the Nomadic Government. The Kurultai members are among the elite of the realm, and should either be appeased or forced into Obedience to assure a smooth Succession.

After the event of a chaotic succession, they may steal some Herd, abandon their new Liege, they will gain a Claim on the Realm Title.
positions.name: Kurultai Member

kurultai steward learn on the job
kurultai marshal learn on the job
kurultai court chaplain learn on the job

positions.desc:
The Minister of Personnel is the Minister in charge of all matters related to Appointments and can greatly impact the Candidate Score of other Characters.

The minister can, for example:
Use Request Retirement Interaction to fire Governors regardless of the Retirement Age Law
Invite any type of Courtier with the Summon Courtiers for the Celestial Bureau Decision
Compel acceptance of the Offer Courtier and Demand Courtier Interactions
Access special Influence Career Interaction options, and at a reduced cost

modifiers.text: -5% Enemy Political Scheme Success Chance Max Add

positions.name: Minister of Personnel

positions.desc:
The Minister of Justice is the Minister in charge of legal affairs and assisting Son of Heaven to maintain a righteous rule.

The minister can, for example:
Start the Establish Control Great Project
Use Imprison Interaction on Vassals and Courtiers, who cannot refuse
Use Grant Pardon Interaction on Characters who have committed Crimes
Use Find Secrets (Scheme) Interaction to find Secrets in Vassal Courts and Imprison or pardon known Criminals
Exposing Secrets will trigger Minister of Justice exposed a Governor Dynastic Cycle Catalyst
Access special Influence Career Interaction options

modifiers.text: -5% Enemy Political Scheme Success Chance Max Add

positions.name: Minister of Justice

positions.desc:
The Minister of Works is the Minister in charge of construction and development throughout the Realm, and may start Great Projects.

The minister can, for example:
Start the Develop Communities Great Project
Start the The Grand Canals Great Project
Start the Improve the Great Wall Great Project
Can construct Buildings and Holdings inside the Realm
Can construct Buildings and Holdings inside Tributaries of Son of Heaven in … Era
Access special Influence Career Interaction options
positions.name: Minister of Works

positions.desc:
The Grand Marshal is the highest ranking commander in the Realm and commands an Army of Title Men-at-Arms.

The Marshal can be the designated Secretary Director, depending on the Grand Secretariat Control Law.

The minister can, for example:
Start the Grand Campaign Great Project
Start the Construct Great Barracks Great Project
Use Seize Hegemonic County and Seize Hegemonic Duchy Casus Bellis in … and … Eras
Access special Influence Career Interaction options
positions.name: Grand Marshal
